articles.summary: 10 July 2026, Shanghai – As travel gains significance among younger generations as a means of self-expression and connection, guest expectations are shifting. With over 230 million Gen Z consumers in Greater China, IHG is ramping up youth-focused initiatives across three key priorities: shared interests, travel value, and destination inspiration. Through partnerships like the King Pro League (KPL), student-exclusive offers, and curated itineraries, IHG is strengthening engagement and fostering long-term loyalty with the next generation of travelers.
articles.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts Deepens Its Commitment to Young Travellers with Curated, Varied Experiences in Greater China

articles.summary: IHG Hotels & Resorts (IHG), one of the world’s leading hotel companies, introduces Vignette Collection to Italy with the opening of The Venice Times Hotel, Vignette Collection, in partnership with Pacini Group. Located in one of the city’s most enviable locations, the 30-room property is now open, and is the latest addition to IHG’s first collection brand underscoring IHG's commitment to strengthening its portfolio in Italy, while leveraging Pacini Group's well-established expertise and presence in the hospitality sector.
articles.title: The Venice Times, Vignette Collection Marks Brand Debut in Italy for IHG Hotels & Resorts
